info.title: RACG
info.description: Manual decisions are local to the server TUI and require a successful audit transaction before execution or rule installation. A storage error leaves the request pending; the operator must resolve it before retrying.

role.description: agent tokens only see their own session's requests; operator tokens audit everything.

stdin_upload_id.description: Session-owned staged content supplied to the process as stdin.

stdin_size.description: Canonical staged stdin size supplied by the server.

stdin_sha256.description: Canonical staged stdin SHA-256 supplied by the server for integrity verification and audit.

run_as.description: Accepted but currently ignored by the executor; server runs in root mode.

size.description: Canonical value supplied by the server.

sha256.description: Canonical value supplied by the server.

key.description: Key name for env or dotted path for json/yaml.

create.description: Create a missing config file with mode 0600. The parent directory must already exist.

ApproverRequest.description: Pending request as visible to an enrolled approver device.

op.description: exact operation bytes; the decision must be signed over this SHA-256

post.summary: Stage binary content for an fs.upload approval request

post.description: If automatic approval cannot be persisted, returns HTTP 500 DECISION_PERSISTENCE_FAILED with error.request_id. The existing request remains pending. Resolve server storage and review that ID in TUI; do not resubmit.

500.description: DECISION_PERSISTENCE_FAILED: existing request remains pending; error.request_id identifies it. Other internal persistence failures may occur before request creation.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: scope=session returns the recent history of the calling token's own session (server-side session claim, newest first, default limit 10). Without it the legacy behavior stays: pending approvals across all sessions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many recent requests to return with scope=session (1-100).

parameters.name: unredacted
parameters.description: Return stored stdout and stderr without display redaction.

parameters.description: Return stored stdout and stderr without display redaction.

post.description: Manual approval and denial are local to the server TUI. Agent tokens never grant decision authority. Authenticated POST requests return 403 REMOTE_DECISION_DISABLED without changing request state or rules. Signed remote approval is not yet available.

403.description: REMOTE_DECISION_DISABLED: approve or deny in the server TUI

200.description: binary file with X-RACG-SHA256 and X-RACG-Mode headers

parameters.name: unredacted
parameters.description: Return raw stdout instead of display-redacted output.

get.summary: Get current live combined request output
get.description: Returns the in-memory combined live output buffer for a request. This is available while a request is running and may be empty before the first output chunk.

parameters.name: unredacted
parameters.description: Return raw live output instead of display-redacted output.

parameters.name: unredacted
parameters.description: Return raw stderr instead of display-redacted output.

get.description: Upgrade this endpoint to WebSocket. Authentication is via Authorization: Bearer <token> header.

parameters.name: unredacted
parameters.description: Return raw request.output chunks instead of display-redacted chunks.

get.description: Returns a random single-use challenge consumed by the next signed approver request (pairing, poll, or decision).

post.description: One-time enrollment: requires the server enrollment token (SHA-256 of the raw 32 token bytes) and an ECDSA P-256 signature from the device key over the racg/approver/pairing/v1 message.

401.description: PAIRING_FAILED: wrong token, stale challenge or invalid signature

get.summary: List pending requests for an enrolled approver device
get.description: Requires signed poll headers: X-Racg-Approver-Device, X-Racg-Approver-Challenge and X-Racg-Approver-Signature (base64 ECDSA P-256 over the racg/approver/poll/v1 message). The challenge is consumed by this call.

get.summary: Get one pending request for an enrolled approver device
get.description: Same signed poll headers as the pending list; the signature binds the exact request path.

post.description: ALLOW_ONCE, ALLOW_SESSION, ALLOW_ALWAYS or DENY, signed by an enrolled device approval key and bound to the exact stored operation SHA-256, a fresh single-use challenge and the server identity. ALLOW_SESSION binds to the target agent session server-side; the phone never sees session IDs. The first valid decision wins; conflicting later decisions are rejected.

400.description: operation mismatch or request no longer pending

401.description: unknown device, invalid signature or stale challenge

404.description: request not found or not pending

get.description: Same signed poll headers as the pending list. Returns session_id, client_id and expires_at for every live auth-token session.

post.description: Device-signed racg/approver/admin/v1 message (approval key) with action sessions.extend. Slides the session expiry by the configured TTL without changing the agent token string.

401.description: invalid admin signature or stale challenge

post.description: Device-signed racg/approver/admin/v1 message (approval key) with action sessions.revoke. Deletes every auth token of the session and closes the audit session.

401.description: invalid admin signature or stale challenge

get.description: Same signed poll headers as the pending list. Returns device_id, created_at, enabled and has_poll_key for every enrolled approver device.

post.summary: Revoke an approver device (signed admin action)
post.description: Device-signed racg/approver/admin/v1 message (approval key) with action devices.revoke. Revoked devices fail poll and decision verification immediately.

401.description: invalid admin signature or stale challenge

post.summary: Mint a fresh agent pairing code (signed admin action)
post.description: Device-signed racg/approver/admin/v1 message (approval key) with action pairing_code. Returns a fresh pairing code for racg login without a server restart.

401.description: invalid admin signature or stale challenge

post.summary: Mint a one-time approver enrollment token (transfer to a new phone)
post.description: Device-signed racg/approver/admin/v1 message (approval key) with action enrollment. Returns a fresh single-use enrollment token (base64 of 32 raw bytes) plus its expiry. The old phone renders a standard setup QR from it; the new phone pairs through the regular /v1/approver/pairing flow. Minting invalidates any previously issued enrollment token; the old device stays enrolled.

401.description: invalid admin signature or stale challenge

post.summary: Stop a running request from the phone (signed admin action)
post.description: Device-signed racg/approver/admin/v1 message (approval key) with action request.kill and target_id = request_id. Cancels pending requests and kills running ones regardless of the owning agent session; terminal-status requests are reported as already finished. The phone history shows each request's owner (client_id).

400.description: action is not request.kill or target_id missing

401.description: invalid admin signature or stale challenge

get.summary: Instant event stream for an enrolled approver device (WebSocket)
get.description: WebSocket upgrade whose handshake is authenticated exactly like a signed poll (poll key or legacy approval key, path-bound). Text frames carry hub events; the phone still reads pending lists through the signed REST endpoint.

post.summary: Mint a single-use approver enrollment token (unix socket only)
post.description: Privileged admin endpoint reachable only over the pipeline unix socket. Invalidates the previous token and issues a fresh single-use one with a 10 minute TTL; used by racg approver-setup.

post.summary: Mint a fresh agent pairing code (unix socket only)
post.description: Privileged admin endpoint reachable only over the pipeline unix socket; used by racg pairing-code.

get.summary: List reusable-scope candidates for a pending request
get.description: Same signed poll headers as the pending list. Returns one candidate per shell script segment (cmd.run) or per path (fs.*/conf.* ops); the timed-grant dialog shows one editable scope line per candidate. Append /scope to the request path.
